dz: 西班牙内战:阿斯图里亚斯和莱昂君主理事会在吉洪宣告成立.
de: Spanish Civil War: Sovereign Council of Asturias and León is proclaimed in Gijón.

t: 根据桑托尼亚协议，巴斯克军队向意大利志愿军投降。
te: the Basque Army surrenders to the Italian Corpo Truppe Volontarie following the Santoña Agreement.
dz: 西班牙内战：根据桑托尼亚协议，巴斯克军队向意大利志愿军投降。
de: Spanish Civil War: the Basque Army surrenders to the Italian Corpo Truppe Volontarie following the Santoña Agreement.

t: 丰田汽车公司成为独立公司.
te: Toyota Motors becomes an independent company.
dz: 丰田汽车公司成为独立公司.
de: Toyota Motors becomes an independent company.

t: 经过一天的围攻，利亚内斯落入民族主义者之手。
te: Llanes falls to the Nationalists following a one-day siege.
dz: 西班牙内战：经过一天的围攻，利亚内斯落入民族主义者之手。
de: Spanish Civil War: Llanes falls to the Nationalists following a one-day siege.

t: 9个国家参加了处理地中海国际海盗行为的尼永会议.
te: Nine nations attend the Nyon Conference to address international piracy in the Mediterranean Sea.
dz: 9个国家参加了处理地中海国际海盗行为的尼永会议.
de: Nine nations attend the Nyon Conference to address international piracy in the Mediterranean Sea.

t: J.R.R.托尔金的《霍比特人》首次出版。 （然而，9 月 22 日被一些粉丝庆祝为霍比特人日…
te: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit is published for the first time. (September 22 is celebrated by some fans as Hobbit Day, ho…
dz: J.R.R.托尔金的《霍比特人》首次出版。 （然而，9 月 22 日被一些粉丝庆祝为霍比特人日。）
de: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit is published for the first time. (September 22 is celebrated by some fans as Hobbit Day, however.)

t: 中国八路军在平型关战役中取得了虽小但鼓舞士气的胜利。
te: The Chinese Eighth Route Army gains a minor, but morale-boosting victory in the Battle of Pingxingguan.
dz: 第二次中日战争：中国八路军在平型关战役中取得了虽小但鼓舞士气的胜利。
de: Second Sino-Japanese War: The Chinese Eighth Route Army gains a minor, but morale-boosting victory in the Battle of Pingxingguan.

t: 拉斐尔·特鲁希略下令处决居住在多米尼加共和国边境地区的海地人.
te: Rafael Trujillo orders the execution of Haitians living in the border region of the Dominican Republic.
dz: 拉斐尔·特鲁希略下令处决居住在多米尼加共和国边境地区的海地人.
de: Rafael Trujillo orders the execution of Haitians living in the border region of the Dominican Republic.

t: 中国正定有9名天主教神父被害,这些神父保护了当地民众免遭日军推进.
te: Murder of 9 Catholic priests in Zhengding, China, who protected the local population from the advancing Japanese army.
dz: 中国正定有9名天主教神父被害,这些神父保护了当地民众免遭日军推进.
de: Murder of 9 Catholic priests in Zhengding, China, who protected the local population from the advancing Japanese army.

t: 温莎公爵和公爵夫人游览纳粹德国 12 天，并于 10 月 22 日会见阿道夫·希特勒。
te: The Duke and Duchess of Windsor tour Nazi Germany for 12 days and meet Adolf Hitler on 22 October.
dz: 温莎公爵和公爵夫人游览纳粹德国 12 天，并于 10 月 22 日会见阿道夫·希特勒。
de: The Duke and Duchess of Windsor tour Nazi Germany for 12 days and meet Adolf Hitler on 22 October.

t: 纳粹德国开始驱逐 18,000 名波兰犹太人。
te: Nazi Germany begins expulsions of 18,000 Polish Jews.
dz: 纳粹德国开始驱逐 18,000 名波兰犹太人。
de: Nazi Germany begins expulsions of 18,000 Polish Jews.

t: 斯大林主义者处决了保罗·汉伯格牧师和阿塞拜疆路德教会的七名成员。
te: Stalinists execute Pastor Paul Hamberg and seven members of Azerbaijan's Lutheran community.
dz: 斯大林主义者处决了保罗·汉伯格牧师和阿塞拜疆路德教会的七名成员。
de: Stalinists execute Pastor Paul Hamberg and seven members of Azerbaijan's Lutheran community.

t: 纳粹展览德·埃维希·朱德 ("永恒的犹太人") 在慕尼黑开幕.
te: The Nazi exhibition Der ewige Jude ("The Eternal Jew") opens in Munich.
dz: 纳粹展览德·埃维希·朱德 ("永恒的犹太人") 在慕尼黑开幕.
de: The Nazi exhibition Der ewige Jude ("The Eternal Jew") opens in Munich.

t: 第二次中日战争：中国军队退出上海战役。
te: The Chinese Army withdraws from the Battle of Shanghai.
dz: 第二次中日战争：中国军队退出上海战役。
de: Second Sino-Japanese War: The Chinese Army withdraws from the Battle of Shanghai.

t: 南京保卫战：日军在浅香康彦中将的指挥下向中国南京城发起进攻。
te: Battle of Nanking: Japanese troops under the command of Lt. Gen. Yasuhiko Asaka launch an assault on the Chinese city o…
dz: 第二次中日战争：南京保卫战：日军在浅香康彦中将的指挥下向中国南京城发起进攻。
de: Second Sino-Japanese War: Battle of Nanking: Japanese troops under the command of Lt. Gen. Yasuhiko Asaka launch an assault on the Chinese city of Nanking.

t: 第二次意大利-埃塞俄比亚战争:意大利退出国际联盟.
te: Italy leaves the League of Nations.
dz: 第二次意大利-埃塞俄比亚战争:意大利退出国际联盟.
de: Second Italo-Ethiopian War: Italy leaves the League of Nations.

t: 班乃号事件：日本飞机在中国长江上轰炸并击沉美国炮舰班乃号。
te: USS Panay incident: Japanese aircraft bomb and sink U.S. gunboat USS Panay on the Yangtze river in China.
dz: 第二次中日战争：班乃号事件：日本飞机在中国长江上轰炸并击沉美国炮舰班乃号。
de: Second Sino-Japanese War: USS Panay incident: Japanese aircraft bomb and sink U.S. gunboat USS Panay on the Yangtze river in China.

t: 南京保卫战：唐生智将军指挥的国民革命军保卫的南京城落入日军之手。随后发生了南京大屠杀，日军强奸…
te: Battle of Nanking: The city of Nanjing, defended by the National Revolutionary Army under the command of General Tang S…
dz: 第二次中日战争：南京保卫战：唐生智将军指挥的国民革命军保卫的南京城落入日军之手。随后发生了南京大屠杀，日军强奸并屠杀了数十万平民。
de: Second Sino-Japanese War: Battle of Nanking: The city of Nanjing, defended by the National Revolutionary Army under the command of General Tang Shengzhi, falls to the Japanese. This is followed by the Nanking Massacre, in which Japanese troops rape and slaughter hundreds of thousands of civilians.

t: 林肯隧道开通 纽约市通车.
te: The Lincoln Tunnel opens to traffic in New York City.
dz: 林肯隧道开通 纽约市通车.
de: The Lincoln Tunnel opens to traffic in New York City.

t: 通过新宪法，爱尔兰自由邦被名为爱尔兰的新国家所取代。
te: The Irish Free State is replaced by a new state called Ireland with the adoption of a new constitution.
dz: 通过新宪法，爱尔兰自由邦被名为爱尔兰的新国家所取代。
de: The Irish Free State is replaced by a new state called Ireland with the adoption of a new constitution.
